text:
Asha Patel: Quick heads-up — got flagged by SDRs about leads that hit enrichment timeout and then got stuck in RR. We lost ~18 leads last 30m. Anyone see spikes?
Tom Nguyen: saw error 504 from enrichment service around 10:12 PDT. HubSpot workflow retried but didn't fallthrough.
Jules Park: ugh. Is this the "claim" route or backfill? @Priya any ticket?
Priya Shah: hooking ticket #3489, adding logs. Suggest we add a hard TTL in HS workflow to branch to fallback owner after 30s.
RouteBot: Auto: Canary deployment of rr-fallback v1 started by @Tom at 3567890150.
Maya Rivera: can we short-circuit at intake lambda instead? quick patch: set hs property lead_enrich_attempts = 1 and route to overflow pool.
Eli Brooks: data shows these leads skew to certain sources (webinars). we can mark high-traffic forms to bypass heavy enrichers.
Asha Patel: plan: 1) Temp HS workflow change: set TTL 30s -> fallback owner; 2) Short-circuit intake for high-volume sources; 3) Canary rr-fallback v1 monitor 15m; 4) Follow-up retro. @Maya can you implement #1? @Tom monitor.
Tom Nguyen: I'll watch canary logs + add alert if fallback rate >5% :eyes: 
Priya Shah: i'll update playbook and notify SDRs. :thumbsup: 
Maya Rivera: pushing patch to hs-workflows now. snippet:
```
IF property 'enrich_status' != 'done' AND time_elapsed > 30s THEN assign 'overflow_team'
```
Maya Rivera: pushed, HubSpot workflow save+publish. verifying.
RouteBot: Auto: Workflow publish succeeded (id wf_6732)
Asha Patel: thanks team. check back in 20m. adding retrospective ticket.
